sentences.en: "One for me, one for Mum and Dad, and one for Gran."
sentences.zh: 一为了我， 一为了妈妈和爸爸， 和一为了 Gran。

sentences.en: "Now I'm famous, and I don't feel any different," Said Wolf.
sentences.zh: 我不感觉任何不同的， 说 Wilf。 不， 说 Wilf。
